## What's Changed

* ui: redesign Dipper around a neutral poster library by @steampixel007 in https://github.com/steampixel007/Dipper/pull/93
* feat: group downloads by anime and fansub group by @steampixel007 in https://github.com/steampixel007/Dipper/pull/94
* scripts: package current MyGo artifacts by @steampixel007 in https://github.com/steampixel007/Dipper/pull/95


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/steampixel007/Dipper/compare/v0.1.2...v0.1.3
